description: This file defines the HomeScreen widget for a Flutter application, which maintains and switches between two tabs: Store and Library, displaying corresponding screens.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that manages the main screen with bottom navigation to switch between Store and Library views.

classes.name: _HomeScreenState
classes.description: State class for HomeScreen that manages the current tab index and page widgets.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the HomeScreen widget, returning an instance of _HomeScreenState.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the HomeScreen, including AppBar, body with selected page, and BottomNavigationBar.
